purpose: Seed trigger evals for the 12 DIAYN public workflow skills. These are ready for future Claude skill-creator trigger evaluation but are not recorded as executed benchmark results.

diayn-init.query: I have a vague app idea and a messy README. Help me initialize DIAYN, ask the missing requirement questions, and create the harness docs before implementation starts.
I only want to read the installation guide for this skill pack, not change my project or create DIAYN scaffold files.

diayn-plan.query: The DIAYN scaffold already exists. Turn the confirmed brief into a stage plan, backend/frontend lane boards, shared contracts, and acceptance criteria.
Run the existing unit tests right now and fix the failing backend assertion.

diayn-worktrees.query: The stage plan is approved. Prepare backend and frontend git worktrees, show the dry-run commands, and request authorization before creating them.
List my local git branches and tell me which one has the latest commit.

diayn-backend.query: I am in the backend lane worktree. Execute the next backend task slice from the DIAYN lane board and stop at candidate_done for review.
Review the backend worker's completed slice and decide whether it should be marked done or rejected.

diayn-frontend.query: I am in the frontend lane worktree. Execute the next frontend task slice from the DIAYN lane board and record evidence for review.
Integrate the reviewed frontend and backend changes into the controller root and run smoke checks.

diayn-review-backend.query: The backend worker stopped at candidate_done. In the same backend worktree, independently test the slice, write review evidence, and mark done or rejected.
Implement the backend authentication endpoint now and mark it candidate_done.

diayn-review-frontend.query: The frontend worker stopped at candidate_done. In the same frontend worktree, independently test the UI slice and either approve or reject it.
Create a new frontend worktree for the approved stage plan.

diayn-sync.query: Both lane reviews are done. Synchronize lane documents and TODO state back to the controller root without merging business code.
Both reviews passed. Merge the lane code and run the integrated build and E2E checks.

diayn-integration.query: Backend and frontend reviews passed and docs are synced. From the controller root, merge or confirm code state, check contracts, run build/smoke/E2E, and prepare the integration summary.
Only copy reviewed lane board updates into TODO.md; do not merge code yet.

diayn-bug.query: Owner acceptance failed because login still breaks after integration. Triage this as a DIAYN bug, update TODO, and route the fix to the right lane.
The current stage is accepted and I want to start a new feature request for reporting.

diayn-new.query: Owner accepted the current stage. Close it out, record the accepted baseline, and prepare the next-stage intake without implementing new code.
A reviewed backend slice was rejected and needs its checkbox cleared with a reason.

diayn-html.query: Generate an Owner-readable HTML report from the DIAYN Markdown artifacts, keeping Markdown as the source of truth.
Design and implement the product's frontend homepage in HTML and CSS.
